I was joined by Chris Davies, investment manager at Baillie Gifford, to cover Moncler's evolution, particularly in the hands of Remo Ruffini. And we get into the push to define luxury outerwear, extend outward into other product categories and keep that core DNA of fashion and function. This is a particularly interesting episode for anybody interested in the luxury market generally and Moncler's push to carve out their own niche.
